title: Direct Recruitment to various posts in Government of India
body_text: UPSC invites applications from eligible candidates for direct recruitment to various posts in Government of India. 2. The detailed Advertisement No. 13/2026 , along-with instructions to the candidates has been uploaded on the Commission’s website https://upsc.gov.in . Interested candidates can apply through the Online Application Portal https://upsconline.nic.in from 14th November, 2026 to 4th December, 2026. 3. Candidates are requested to follow the detailed instructions mentioned therein. ***** NKR/NM
